name: maestro-medium
purpose: Phase 3b — bigger run to test whether more capacity beats run0's 27M/val-1.875. 12 layers ~41M params, stronger dropout (0.15) since MAESTRO is only ~23M tokens and run0 showed the early edge of overfitting. batch 32 (12 layers @ 32 ~= 8 layers @ 48 in activation memory, fits the 32GB card with headroom). Best-val checkpointed; if val doesn't beat 1.875 we keep run0.
